assumptions: Invested days earn full SPX daily return; flat days earn 0% (no cash yield credit).
Trades execute at the close of the signal day; the invested return begins the next trading day.
No transaction costs, taxes, or slippage. Whipsaw count surfaces flip frequency.
SPX daily closes are index level (Yahoo ^GSPC), so no reinvested dividends.

strategies.name: Buy_and_Hold
strategies.description: Baseline. Always invested in S&P 500. Sets the bar every other strategy has to clear.

strategies.name: Trend_Only
strategies.description: Regime filter: invested when SPX is above its 200-day moving average, out otherwise. No sentiment input.

strategies.name: CNN_ExtremeFear_25_55
strategies.description: Buy when CNN <= 25, sell when CNN >= 55. Pure fear-buying with a neutral exit.

strategies.name: CNN_ExtremeFear_20_50
strategies.description: Tighter fear entry: buy when CNN <= 20, sell when CNN >= 50.

strategies.name: CNN_Fear_plus_Trend
strategies.description: Buy when CNN <= 25 AND SPX > 200MA (trend filter). Exit on CNN >= 55 OR trend break.

strategies.name: BATS_Low_25_55
strategies.description: Buy when BATS <= 25, sell when BATS >= 55. Pure BATS-buying.

strategies.name: BATS_Low_30_60
strategies.description: Looser BATS entry: buy when BATS <= 30, sell when BATS >= 60.

strategies.name: BATS_Low_plus_Trend
strategies.description: Buy when BATS <= 30 AND SPX > 200MA. Exit on BATS >= 60 OR trend break.

strategies.name: CNN_AND_BATS_Both_Low
strategies.description: Strict combined: buy only when CNN <= 25 AND BATS <= 30. Exit when either rises above its threshold (55 / 60).

strategies.name: CNN_OR_BATS_Either_Low
strategies.description: Loose combined: buy when CNN <= 25 OR BATS <= 30. Exit only when BOTH have risen above thresholds.
